Merge branch 'main' of github.com:rapidaai/voice-ai-pro

feat: auto-configure env per profile using compose override file

Introduce docker-compose.knowledge.yml as a Compose override so users
never need to edit env files when switching between profiles:

- Without knowledge: `docker compose -f docker-compose.yml up -d`
  - 8 services (no opensearch / document-api)
  - UI: features.knowledge = false
  - assistant-api: no OpenSearch config

- With knowledge: `docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.knowledge.yml up -d`
  - 10 services (opensearch + document-api added)
  - UI: config.development.knowledge.json mounted → features.knowledge = true
  - assistant-api: OPENSEARCH__* injected via environment override

Additional changes:
- Remove opensearch/document-api from docker-compose.yml profiles (moved to knowledge overlay)
- Add COMPOSE_KNOWLEDGE variable to Makefile replacing COMPOSE_PROFILES=knowledge
- Uncomment DOCUMENT_HOST in web-api and assistant-api base env files (required by Go config)
- Add docker/ui/config.development.knowledge.json with knowledge feature enabled

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Merge branch 'feat/upgrade-document-api-protos' of github.com:rapidaai/voice-ai-pro

fix: make OpenSearch config safely optional for non-knowledge deployments

- Remove validate:"required" from MaxRetries and MaxConnection in
  OpenSearchConfig — the struct is already optional (pointer field),
  so inner int fields must not be required or partial initialization
  (e.g. HOST set but MAX_RETRIES missing) would fail startup validation
- Remove commented-out OPENSEARCH__ vars from .assistant.env — that
  config belongs exclusively in docker-compose.knowledge.yml and should

feat: Add Telnyx telephony provider

Implements Telnyx Call Control API + WebSocket streaming for the Rapida
voice-ai platform.

- `telephony.go`: Implements the Telephony interface for Telnyx
  - OutboundCall: POST to Telnyx Call Control API with stream_url
  - ReceiveCall: Parse inbound call webhooks
  - InboundCall: Return JSON to initiate WebSocket streaming
  - StatusCallback: Handle Telnyx webhook events (call.answered, etc.)
  - Auth: Extract api_key and connection_id from vault credentials
  - HangupCall: Gracefully terminate calls via Call Control API

- `websocket.go`: Implements bidirectional audio streaming
  - Handles Telnyx JSON WebSocket protocol (start/media/stop events)
  - Audio resampling: PCMU 8kHz <-> Linear16 16kHz
  - Media events: base64-encoded PCMU audio
  - DTMF support and audio interruption (clear command)

- Factory updates in `telephony.go`:
  - Added `Telnyx` constant to Telephony enum
  - Added cases in GetTelephony() and NewStreamer()

- start: `{"event":"start","stream_id":"...","start":{...}}`
- media: `{"event":"media","media":{"payload":"<base64>"}}`
- stop: `{"event":"stop","stop":{"call_control_id":"..."}}`
- clear: `{"event":"clear","stream_id":"..."}`
- dtmf: `{"event":"dtmf","dtmf":{"digit":"1"}}`

- Unit tests for telephony.go (StatusCallback, ReceiveCall, Auth)
- WebSocket event parsing tests
- Interface compliance check

- No hardcoded credentials
- All secrets from vault credentials (api_key, connection_id)
